label: preparing
what: An innkeeper's civic presentation/appreciation of municipal public service, arranged for Day 1 at 18:00 in the town hall great hall. The mayor was initially not told the specific presentation and preparations, but subsequently approved it; builders/tradespeople supported preparations, with builder providing presentation-related materials to baker and baker storing them. Freight and builder/baker also produced and staged bread. Secretary knowingly handled the private appointment coordination and approval record; builder, baker, and freight knowingly contributed practical preparation. The record does not establish every bread activity was presentation-related, but combined evidence supports this preparation strongly.
